purpose: Test a faithful Hiku primary order and two experts that use FaaSRank or Jiagu only as a final tie-break after identical Hiku container-state and load keys on fresh E71-E75; all 60 runs remain blinded until QC and pairing complete.

fresh_development_cohort.reason: E71-E75 were declared in the V31 full source manifest but were never captured, referenced, executed, or inspected; E21-E70 are closed and E11-E20 remain sealed.

source.high_profile_note: Frozen high remains 7k; V32 is low only.

diagnostic_basis.closed_v31_observation: Hiku ranked first in both low-load mean fixed-window throughput and mean QPR on E66-E70; every V31 candidate failed the combined gate.
diagnostic_basis.hiku_primary_order: For each function, Hiku first consumes one idle running-container token ordered by pre-window pending-plus-running task count, then falls back to running, starting, and absent container states ordered by pending-plus-running plus same-window projected placements.
diagnostic_basis.candidate_b_constraint: FaaSRank may compare nodes only after Hiku container-state and load keys are exactly equal.
diagnostic_basis.candidate_c_constraint: Jiagu may compare nodes only after Hiku container-state and load keys are exactly equal.

router_inputs: current pending and running task counts
frozen FaaSRank state or current Jiagu state only for exact primary ties

development_matrix.result_blind_execution_order: Commit before capture; build and run serially; reveal after all QC and pairing.

eligibility_per_candidate: mean fixed-window throughput strictly exceeds all nine baseline means
mean QPR strictly exceeds all nine baseline means
frozen V8 middle/high retain first place in both metrics
selection_rule: Freeze the first passing candidate in fixed v32a, v32b, v32c priority; ties fail; otherwise select none and close E71-E75.

confirmation.closure_requirement: First in mean throughput and QPR for every load against frozen E11-E20 baselines.
